clc2018.title: CORINE Land Cover 2018 (vector, EEA DISCOMAP CLC2018_LAEA)
clc2018.provider: European Environment Agency / Copernicus Land Monitoring Service
clc2018.licence: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service data policy / EEA standard re-use
clc2018.thematic: 44 CLC classes, MMU 25 ha, minimum mapping width 100 m. Generalized land-cover inventory, not 10 m parcels.

hrl_tcd_2018.title: Copernicus HRL Tree Cover Density 2018
hrl_tcd_2018.provider: European Environment Agency / Copernicus Land Monitoring Service
hrl_tcd_2018.licence: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service data policy
hrl_tcd_2018.thematic: Tree cover density 0–100 (crown cover). Not a forest-area mask. 0 is valid; 255 is nodata.

hrl_imd_2018.title: Copernicus HRL Imperviousness Density 2018
hrl_imd_2018.provider: European Environment Agency / Copernicus Land Monitoring Service
hrl_imd_2018.licence: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service data policy
hrl_imd_2018.thematic: Imperviousness density 0–100 (sealing). Not a binary built-up footprint. 0 is valid; 255 is nodata.

hrl_waw_2018.title: Copernicus HRL Water and Wetness 2018
hrl_waw_2018.provider: European Environment Agency / Copernicus Land Monitoring Service
hrl_waw_2018.licence: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service data policy
hrl_waw_2018.thematic: Classified water/wetness: 0 dry, 1 permanent water, 2 temporary water, 3 permanent wet, 4 temporary wet, 254 unclassifiable, 255 nodata. Not a river network or flood zone.

hrl_fty_2018.title: Copernicus HRL Forest Type 2018
hrl_fty_2018.provider: European Environment Agency / Copernicus Land Monitoring Service
hrl_fty_2018.licence: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service data policy
hrl_fty_2018.thematic: FAO-like forest mask after agricultural/urban tree removal. 0 non-forest, 1 broadleaved, 2 coniferous. Distinct from Tree Cover Density.

notes: CLC is a generalized 25 ha inventory. Do not imply parcel-level precision.
HRL Tree Cover Density is crown-cover density, not CLC forest area.
HRL Imperviousness Density is sealing density, not a binary building footprint.
HRL Water and Wetness classes are not a river network, flood zone, or catchment.
Settlement composition is clipped to M4 OSM admin_level=9 boundaries.
